sentences.text: Nils skal skrive om fiskere. Han har lekse, og han er hos Marta.
sentences.english: Nils is going to write about fishermen. He has homework, and he is at Marta's.

sentences.text: Hva vet du om fiskere, bestemor?
sentences.english: What do you know about fishermen, grandmother?
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Jeg vet litt. Fiskerne bor nær havet. De har båt, og de drar ut på havet.
sentences.english: I know a little. The fishermen live near the sea. They have a boat, and they go out onto the sea.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Hva gjør de på havet?
sentences.english: What do they do on the sea?
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: De fanger fisk. Det er et vanskelig liv, for været er ofte dårlig.
sentences.english: They catch fish. It is a difficult life, because the weather is often bad.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Spiser vi fisk fra havet?
sentences.english: Do we eat fish from the sea?
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Ja. Fisken i butikken og på markedet kommer fra fiskerne.
sentences.english: Yes. The fish in the shop and at the market comes from the fishermen.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Nils leser mer i en bok om fisk. Boka forteller om tørrfisk.
sentences.english: Nils reads more in a book about fish. The book tells about dried fish.

sentences.text: Tørrfisk er fisk som er tørr. Den blir tørr, og folk kan spise den lenge etterpå.
sentences.english: Dried fish is fish that is dry. It becomes dry, and people can eat it a long time afterwards.

sentences.text: Har du spist tørrfisk, bestemor?
sentences.english: Have you eaten dried fish, grandmother?
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Ja, mange ganger. Jeg likte den ikke da jeg var liten, men nå liker jeg den.
sentences.english: Yes, many times. I did not like it when I was small, but now I like it.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Jeg liker ikke tørrfisk. Jeg liker ferdig fisk og poteter.
sentences.english: I do not like dried fish. I like ready-made fish and potatoes.
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Du får lære å like den! Nå må du skrive, Nils.
sentences.english: You will learn to like it! Now you must write, Nils.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Nils skrev: «Fiskere bor nær havet. De har båt, og de fanger fisk. Tørrfisk er fisk som er tørr. Jeg liker ikke tørrfisk, men jeg liker fiskerne.»
sentences.english: Nils wrote: "Fishermen live near the sea. They have a boat, and they catch fish. Dried fish is fish that is dry. I do not like dried fish, but I like the fishermen."

sentences.text: Lars leste prosjektet på skolen. Han sa at det var godt.
sentences.english: Lars read the project at school. He said that it was good.

sentences.text: Får jeg kake nå, bestemor? Jeg har skrevet mye i dag.
sentences.english: May I have cake now, grandmother? I have written a lot today.
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Ja, du har jobbet bra. Her er kake og melk.
sentences.english: Yes, you have worked well. Here is cake and milk.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Nils er glad. Han spiser kake og drikker melk. Så går han hjem, og han sover godt.
sentences.english: Nils is happy. He eats cake and drinks milk. Then he goes home, and he sleeps well.

sentences.text: Ingen var redd for jenta på brua, for hun var klok. Hun stoppet og svarte på gåter.
sentences.english: Nobody was afraid of the girl on the bridge, because she was clever. She stopped and answered riddles.

sentences.text: Noen skriver nynorsk, og noen skriver bokmål. Det er to måter, og begge er bra. Dialektene er forskjellige, men det er bra.
sentences.english: Some write Nynorsk, and some write Bokmål. There are two ways, and both are good. The dialects are different, but that is fine.

sentences.text: Etter tilbudet fra sykehuset snakket Anna om valget. Hun ville ikke flytte nå, men kanskje senere. Sjefen svarte.
sentences.english: After the offer from the hospital Anna talked about the choice. She did not want to move now, but maybe later. The boss answered.

sentences.text: Anna hørte hva Lars sa om Oslo, men hun ville ikke flytte nå.
sentences.english: Anna heard what Lars said about Oslo, but she did not want to move now.
